$schema.description: JSON schema reference, for editor support.

linkFolder.description: Your project: the folder you edit. Relative paths are resolved from the folder containing this config file.

outputFolder.description: Where the mirror is created; run your dev server here. Relative paths are resolved from the folder containing this config file. It must not overlap the project. Its contents are deleted on start (after asking) and the mirror is removed on exit.

watch.description: Files or folders (relative to linkFolder) whose edits are held back until a flush, usually your sources. They are copied into the mirror; everything else is symlinked.

commitTriggers.description: Files (relative to linkFolder) that flush all pending changes whenever they are created, modified or deleted. `folder-debouncer --flush` writes the first one.

ignore.description: Files or folders (relative to linkFolder) that are left out of the mirror and never watched.
